title: Oracle database security evidence baseline
description: Declarative, read-only evidence requests for encryption, data protection, access security, and masking governance in customer-validated Oracle environments.

controls.title: Review tablespace encryption metadata
controls.objective: Collect the declared encryption state of Oracle tablespaces so an authorized reviewer can compare it with the approved encryption policy and documented exceptions.

applicability.notes: Validate catalog access and expected tablespace exclusions for the exact Oracle edition and release.

limitations: The probe reports catalog metadata and does not verify key custody, wallet availability, backup encryption, or recoverability.
An unencrypted entry is not automatically a control failure because approved exclusions may apply.

remediation.guidance: Confirm the policy scope, edition and licensing, key-management design, recovery plan, and maintenance window before an Oracle administrator changes encryption configuration.

controls.title: Review unified auditing option metadata
controls.objective: Collect the Oracle option state associated with unified auditing for comparison with the approved audit architecture and evidence-retention requirements.

applicability.notes: Interpret the option value with the database release, deployment mode, and approved audit design.

limitations: The option state does not demonstrate that required audit policies are enabled, forwarded, retained, monitored, or protected from alteration.

remediation.guidance: Have the control owner and Oracle administrator review the required audit events, enabled policies, storage capacity, forwarding, access restrictions, and retention before approving changes.

controls.title: Review database account posture metadata
controls.objective: Collect account status, authentication type, and profile assignment so an authorized reviewer can identify candidates for lifecycle and least-privilege review.

applicability.notes: Treat usernames as security metadata and correlate them only through approved identity-governance processes.

limitations: The probe does not collect role grants, effective object privileges, usage history, external identity state, or business ownership.
Account status alone cannot establish whether access is authorized or excessive.

remediation.guidance: Obtain owner confirmation, analyze effective privilege and recent use, preserve emergency-access requirements, and follow the approved account quarantine process before changing an account.

controls.title: Review masking governance evidence
controls.objective: Require approved evidence that non-production Oracle data uses appropriate masking techniques and that privacy, referential integrity, and application utility were validated.

applicability.notes: No masking probe is approved in the current collector catalog, so evidence review remains manual.

manual_evidence_requirements: Approved masking policy and scoped data classification
Execution record from the authorized masking mechanism

limitations: This control does not execute masking, inspect raw values, or assert that a particular Oracle feature or license is available.
Document presence alone does not establish masking effectiveness; an authorized reviewer must evaluate the evidence.

remediation.guidance: Define the approved masking technique and execution boundary, obtain data-owner and privacy approval, test re-identification risk and referential integrity, then attach the signed validation evidence.
